verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a stateless URL-to-markdown API. The evidence shows one-shot fetch options only: forwarding session cookies via X-Set-Cookie, choosing a headless-Chrome engine, and waiting for a selector. None of the evidence shows a persistent session where you can keep interacting with an already-scraped page by clicking or filling forms. Cookie forwarding is a related control that can reach logged-in content, but it is not the interactive capability this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall
